//: Versioning is derived from Conventional Commit subjects, which are trustworthy here only because the repo is squash-merge-only and the PR title (which becomes the squashed commit subject) is linted by ci.yml. Replaces scripts/bump_version.py and semantic-release. The five groups below mirror how the repo actually ships: backend+frontend+desktop move as one product version (as bump_version.py enforced by hand), everything else moves on its own cadence.

..//: The product version: backend, frontend and desktop share it. pyproject.toml is the anchor because clawbits/fastapi/version_check.py:server_version() reads it at runtime. uv.lock and desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock are deliberately NOT listed: neither can be addressed by jsonpath, `uv sync --frozen` and `cargo build` both tolerate the drift, and each self-heals on the next `uv lock` / `cargo build`.
..//exclude-paths: A root package matches EVERY file in the repo, so without this a `feat(plugin):` would bump the product version as well as the plugin's. These are the paths that version on their own (the four packages below) or do not ship a version at all (web, ironclaw-channel).

plugin.//: Keeps the existing openclaw-plugin-v* tag namespace. The tools and channel packages share this one version by construction now that a single job publishes both.

apps/mobile.//: scripts/sync_native_versions.py still mirrors this into CFBundleShortVersionString / versionCode; its leader file is the one release-please writes here.
